name: frame-selection-simple
description: FEAT-A: select an item, trigger frame-selection via the NavCluster button then the Z shortcut, and confirm the orbit camera dollies/retargets onto the selection. Simple mode (frameSelection is a simple-tier flag, on by default).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode — expected uiMode=simple

steps.name: verify-flag-on
steps.eval: (() => { const on = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.frameSelection; if (!on) throw new Error('frameSelection flag expected ON by default in Simple'); })()

steps.name: seed-item
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id: 'frame-test-sofa', defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [9.2, 2.2], rotation: 0, props: {} }])

steps.name: navcluster-button-visible
steps.failMessage: NavCluster 'Frame selection' button did not mount with an active selection

steps.name: capture-before-state
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; const ct = window.__three.controls; const ip = { x: 9.2, y: 0.425, z: 2.2 }; window.__before = { camPos: [c.position.x, c.position.y, c.position.z], target: [ct.target.x, ct.target.y, ct.target.z], distToItem: Math.hypot(c.position.x-ip.x, c.position.y-ip.y, c.position.z-ip.z), targetDistToItem: Math.hypot(ct.target.x-ip.x, ct.target.y-ip.y, ct.target.z-ip.z) }; })()

steps.name: wait-frame-nonce
steps.failMessage: Clicking the NavCluster button never bumped frameNonce

steps.name: capture-after-button-state
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; const ct = window.__three.controls; const ip = { x: 9.2, y: 0.425, z: 2.2 }; window.__afterButton = { camPos: [c.position.x, c.position.y, c.position.z], target: [ct.target.x, ct.target.y, ct.target.z], distToItem: Math.hypot(c.position.x-ip.x, c.position.y-ip.y, c.position.z-ip.z), targetDistToItem: Math.hypot(ct.target.x-ip.x, ct.target.y-ip.y, ct.target.z-ip.z) }; })()

steps.name: log-button-probe
steps.eval: console.log('FRAME_PROBE_BUTTON', JSON.stringify({ before: window.__before, after: window.__afterButton }))

steps.name: assert-target-landed-on-item
steps.eval: (() => { if (!(window.__afterButton.targetDistToItem < 0.6)) throw new Error('orbit target did not land on the selected item: ' + JSON.stringify(window.__afterButton)); })()

steps.name: assert-camera-dollied-in
steps.eval: (() => { const b = window.__before, a = window.__afterButton; if (!(a.distToItem < b.distToItem)) throw new Error('camera did not move closer to the (small) selection: ' + JSON.stringify({ before: b, after: a })); if (!(a.distToItem < 6)) throw new Error('post-frame camera distance looks too far for a single sofa: ' + a.distToItem); })()

steps.name: capture-before-keyboard-state
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; const ip = { x: 9.2, y: 0.425, z: 2.2 }; window.__beforeKey = { distToItem: Math.hypot(c.position.x-ip.x, c.position.y-ip.y, c.position.z-ip.z), nonce: window.__store.getState().frameNonce }; })()

steps.name: wait-frame-nonce-2
steps.failMessage: Pressing Z never bumped frameNonce a second time

steps.name: assert-keyboard-also-dollied-in
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; const ip = { x: 9.2, y: 0.425, z: 2.2 }; const dist = Math.hypot(c.position.x-ip.x, c.position.y-ip.y, c.position.z-ip.z); console.log('FRAME_PROBE_KEYBOARD', JSON.stringify({ beforeKeyDist: window.__beforeKey.distToItem, afterKeyDist: dist })); if (!(dist < window.__beforeKey.distToItem)) throw new Error('Z shortcut did not dolly the camera closer: ' + JSON.stringify({ before: window.__beforeKey.distToItem, after: dist })); if (!(dist < 6)) throw new Error('post-frame (keyboard) camera distance looks too far: ' + dist); })()
